how: Each flagged row re-run on Google Maps (2026-11-24, one query at a time, the row's q and the name alone where Maps landed elsewhere), the address on the place page compared with the row; temporarily closed places checked with a web search and the place's own or an official page. Rows removed when Maps shows this very place permanently closed, or temporarily closed with no reopening date.

rows.name: Luigia
rows.evidence: Maps: Luigia, Rixos Premium - Jumeirah Beach Residence, 'Temporarily closed'. Rixos only says Luigia 'returns with a renewed look', no date; luigia.ae answers 503. Closed for renovation with no reopening date.
